staff_directory_v.definition:
SELECT u.id,
    u.full_name,
    u.employee_code,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN u.email
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS email,
    u.primary_role,
    u.department,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN u.mobile
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS mobile,
    u.branch_id,
    b.branch_code,
    b.name AS branch_name,
    u.is_active,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN p.id IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
        END AS has_pin,
        CASE
            WHEN (auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role])) AND p.locked_until > now() THEN p.locked_until
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS pin_locked_until,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN COALESCE(p.rotated_at, p.set_at)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS pin_set_at,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN au.id IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
        END AS has_auth_account,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN au.last_sign_in_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS last_sign_in_at,
        CASE
            WHEN auth_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['Owner'::system_role, 'Admin'::system_role]) THEN au.email_confirmed_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS email_confirmed_at
   FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = u.branch_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_auth_pins p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.revoked_at IS NULL
     LEFT JOIN auth.users au ON au.id = u.id
  WHERE u.deactivated_at IS NULL AND u.is_active = true AND auth_is_staff();
